events.outcome: CIN 1 remains documented at AZN3.99/30 days with one-way blocking after expiry if neither the fee nor a top-up is made, plus an AZN0.99/6-day extension option, but CIN 1 now appears in Bakcell’s tariff archive rather than the current GO tariff surface.

data.acquisitionSummary: Bakcell still documents CIN 1 for existing subscribers, but the product is on the tariff-archive page while the current tariff page presents GO plans. A current new-subscription path for CIN 1 is therefore not established.

keep.action: For an existing CIN 1 line, paying the AZN3.99 subscription fee keeps the line open for 30 days. Bakcell also documents an AZN0.99 option that keeps the line active for 6 days from 2025-10-22; neither proves current new acquisition of CIN 1.

data.chinaActivation: No mainland-China remote acquisition path for CIN 1 is established. Bakcell has a separate TravelSIM product for visitors, but that is not the CIN 1 route.
data.kyc: Current CIN 1-specific new-customer identity requirements are not reconciled because the tariff is archived. Bakcell’s current ecosystem uses identity verification for SIM activation and provides separate visitor products.
data.payment: Bakcell supports online/app balance top-up and documents top-up amounts from AZN1 to AZN250. Exact foreign-card acceptance is not established.
data.roamingSms: Bakcell support documents roaming activation, including contacting customer service from abroad. Current incoming-SMS/OTP behavior for CIN 1 while roaming is not independently reproduced.
data.holdReason: CIN 1 has clear existing-line lifecycle and low-cost extension rules, but it is now an archived tariff and the current public tariff surface is GO. New acquisition plus current overseas OTP behavior remain unresolved. The deeper 1-month/150-day/90-day closure sequence comes from a dated 2018 Bakcell statement and is not treated as current policy.
data.tariffSummary: Existing CIN 1 lines: AZN3.99/30 days; if not renewed or topped up, the number becomes one-way blocked. From 2025-10-22, AZN0.99 can keep the line active for 6 days. CIN 1 is archived, so current new acquisition is unproven.
guideSteps: Use the AZN3.99/30-day rule only for existing CIN 1 lines.
Do not present CIN 1 as currently purchasable while it remains in Bakcell’s tariff archive.
Treat the 2018 closure sequence as historical corroboration only until Bakcell republishes a current full deactivation timeline.
